notes: At USD 5 the entry plan is exactly the boundary, not under it, and the per-TB price is the worst. It qualifies on absolute price and on the 7-day refund, not on value per TB. Sustained-rate conversion: 2 TB/month = 6.17 Mbit/s; 1 TiB/month = 3.39 Mbit/s. Candidates considered for the real constraint: the 150 GB disk (forces 7 cycles for 1 TiB), the upload allowance, the 10 Gbps shared port; the disk is the practical limit and the allowance is the priced one. cheapseedboxes.com states that EvoSeedbox and Iseedfast are its own seedbox services; they are recorded as separate brands because they have separate sites, prices and plan structures. The cheapest app-inclusive seedbox found at USD 5, but the number that matters - how much disk and how much upload the USD 5 buys - is the one the page would not give up. Treat USD 5 as the entry price and the quota as unverified until the plan cards are read in a browser.
